_meta._source: Official ASCCC TMC PDFs (tmc/source_pdfs/*.pdf), extracted by the OR-extraction workflow: per-template VISUAL PDF read + independent adversarial verification.
_meta._semantics: Each group = the C-IDs that satisfy ONE requirement line where the official template joins them with "OR" (pick ONE). tmc/_parse_tmc_pdfs.py FOLDS a group into a single slot: the first member that is an existing parsed slot in the named section becomes the slot cid, the remaining members become its alts[]; the other folded slots are removed. This is DISTINCT from a "Select N of many" list (already modeled by section.select).
_meta._note: DRAFT — faculty-verify. Curated/authored data: edit here to correct an OR-group, then re-run tmc/_parse_tmc_pdfs.py. A group whose members are NOT existing slots in the named section, or that overlaps another group on a shared member, is recorded but NOT folded (the parser logs it); those need a manual slot-add / disambiguation.
